reason: In app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:182, `.topic-map h3` sets `color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` instead of `(20%, 80%)`, giving a 50% light-theme lightness. This diverges from app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:321, which uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))`.
